summary: Qualitative verification of agentic-phase-specialist passed against the four delta specs, design.md Decision 2–5, and tasks.md done criteria. Production gating fires on Verifier.Verify (lucind-ai accept) and ExecuteAttempt CHECKING (feature-targeted lucind-ai run); exclusive-mode Integrate remains an ungated residual; task 4.1 is correctly out of lane authority.

findings.finding: The accept and feature-targeted attempt gates fire on the real production call paths, not only in unit fixtures. Verifier.Verify skips CheckPolicySnapshot and v.check unless SDDPhase is empty or "apply", after validateResultAndScope. ExecuteAttempt skips checkFunc only when every combined lane is a declared non-apply phase; nil ledger, empty branches, lookup error, empty SDDPhase, and "apply" all fail closed to running checks. Lease renewal still starts around the CHECKING window; integrate.Check is unchanged.

findings.finding: Exclusive/legacy_main lucind-ai run still invokes Integrate, which calls deps.RunChecks unconditionally (including bisection tryCombine). Design Decision 2 names only accept.go and ExecuteAttempt CHECKING as gated call sites, so this is a residual exclusive-mode path rather than a missed Decision 2 site. Isolated feature-targeted runs (the SDD default) go through IntegrateFeature and are gated. A planning batch dispatched with --legacy-main would still pay the full Go suite on combine.

findings.finding: The spec, design testing strategy, and acceptance-promotion checklist mention an explicit check exception that would force lucind-checks.sh on a non-apply phase. LaneMetadata has SDDPhase and no exception field. tasks.md Open Questions and design.md:140 leave --force-checks vs packet-level exception unresolved and say do not add schema. Empty/missing unlabeled lanes already fail closed to running checks. The exception half of the unlabeled-or-exception scenario is vacuously unimplemented: there is no way to configure it, so the skip for a declared non-apply phase cannot currently be overridden.

findings.finding: RecoverAttempt's non-CASPending replay rebuilds AttemptRequest.Branches as []string{worktree.BranchFor(att.ID)} rather than the original combined lane IDs. shouldRunAttemptChecks then looks up metadata for that attempt-id lane; a miss fail-closes to running checks. A crashed planning-phase feature attempt that resumes would therefore re-run lucind-checks.sh even when every original combined lane was a declared non-apply phase.
findings.evidence: internal/run/attempt.go:710-721 (Branches: worktree.BranchFor(att.ID)); shouldRunAttemptChecks:388-393 (err != nil → return true); worktree.go:83-85
findings.affects: Planning-phase feature-attempt crash recovery; ExecuteAttempt fail-closed conservative extension
